# NodeGraph (UsdShade node graph)

A UsdShade NodeGraph of a render material (for example an MDL or preview-surface network below a [Material](glossary.md#material)). It has no physics of its own: the parser, the [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) backend and usdLoad read none of its schema's attributes. It is a component only so the [compiled stage cache](glossary.md#compiled-stage-cache) does not bypass a Stage that contains it; its rows still enter the identity through the [structural columns](prim.md#columns), so a hit needs the same stage structure.

- **Type chain:** [`Typed`](glossary.md#typed)
- **Applicable APIs:** [`CollectionAPI`](CollectionAPI.md), [`GeomInstanceAPI`](GeomInstanceAPI.md), [`GeomInstanceRootAPI`](GeomInstanceRootAPI.md), [`GeomPrototypeAPI`](GeomPrototypeAPI.md), [`PhysicsMaterialAPI`](PhysicsMaterialAPI.md), [`PhysxMaterialAPI`](PhysxMaterialAPI.md), [`PhysxSceneAPI`](PhysxSceneAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleAutoGearBoxAPI`](PhysxVehicleAutoGearBoxAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleClutchAPI`](PhysxVehicleClutchAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleDriveBasicAPI`](PhysxVehicleDriveBasicAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI`](PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleEngineAPI`](PhysxVehicleEngineAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleGearsAPI`](PhysxVehicleGearsAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleNonlinearCommandResponseAPI`](PhysxVehicleNonlinearCommandResponseAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleSuspensionAPI`](PhysxVehicleSuspensionAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleTireAPI`](PhysxVehicleTireAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleWheelAPI`](PhysxVehicleWheelAPI.md), [`PrototypeRootAPI`](PrototypeRootAPI.md)
- **Transform columns:** none, not [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable)
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## What USD population writes

Written by [USD](glossary.md#usd) population when a RENDERING description is populated beside the physics description (as [IsaacLab](glossary.md#isaaclab) populates), which keeps render prims; the physics description alone leaves it out.
